# J2ME Midlets

J2ME midlets for phones.

## Applications

- **[ReadManiac](./readmaniac.md)**<br/>
  A J2ME reader for large text files on Siemens and Nokia phones.
- **[SMS Sender](./sms-sender.md)**<br/>
  A J2ME application for sending SMS from Siemens phones.
- **[SMS Translit](./sms-translit.md)**<br/>
  Enter SMS messages in Cyrillic with transliteration before sending on Siemens Java phones.
